seoTitle: Pomodoro Timer with Notifications and Session Count
metaDescription: Pomodoro focus and break timer with sound, optional browser notifications and a count of finished sessions.
intro: Cycles focus, short break and long break intervals you set, beeps and optionally notifies at each change, and counts focus sessions.
why:
The Pomodoro method alternates focus and rest. Here you set the lengths and how many sessions come before a long break.

Allow notifications if you want a pop-up when the tab is hidden. Browsers may slow timers in background tabs, so the end time is checked against the clock.
howTo: Set focus, break and long break minutes.
Allow notifications if you want them.

faq.a: Yes. Press Enable notifications. Without it you still get a sound.

faq.q: Will it run in a background tab?
faq.a: Usually, but browsers may delay checks by a few seconds.
No, it resets when you leave the page.
